lastCompletedStory.title: Gitignore the implement-blocked marker so it stops tripping the clean-tree gate

nextStoryContext: US-001 added a single explicit .gitignore entry for .claude/.cam-implement-blocked.json (near .gitignore:91, mirroring the .cam-plan-preflight-failed.json / .cam-post-merge-stalled.json siblings) plus a real-git regression test (test/integration/gitignore-implement-blocked-marker.test.ts) proving `git status --porcelain` stays clean with an orphaned marker on disk. Only root .gitignore was touched, per notes -- templates/.gitignore was deliberately left alone (it already lacks several sibling marker entries too, e.g. .cam-plan-preflight-failed.json/.cam-post-merge-stalled.json/.cam-ship-stalled.json, a pre-existing gap out of scope here). US-002 (issueId-based orphan sweep) can now build on IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME / readImplementBlockedMarker / removeImplementBlockedMarker (src/supervisor/implement-blocked-marker.ts) and readBacklogFromMain / numericIdSuffix (src/issues/backlog.ts) per its notes; the existing clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue in src/commands/sidecar.ts:558-569 must stay unchanged.
